replies.author: TheMasterCow
replies.body:
Listen, here's the history of this map. Cezbla showed me his map on Rage INC's server, and I took a liking to it. He pulled me aside for that and then asked if I wanted to see his KitPvP map (which is this). I didn't mind, so I went to see that. Upon looking at it, I really did like it and it was safely of high quality. It was made into an Avicus version which after that, I enjoyed and with that it was turned into a Nexus/TDM map, shortly being into a OiTN map. I told him specifically to make a forumpost, and he did. After some tweaks and stuff, I decided it was worthy for playtesting.

There is no favoritism or bias for this map. I would have done it for anyone else and I have done it before.
